description: The Ghost is a solo aerospace project focused on mathematical rocket propulsion modeling. The project will calculate optimal vacuum nozzle efficiency and Delta-V mass ratios for lunar landing missions.
summary: Project Ghost: TEST STAND 39 (AERODYN-LUNAR Propulsion Lab) is an interactive rocket propulsion simulator and static hot-fire testbed built on first-principles aerospace thermodynamics. Using a Newton-Raphson solver for isentropic area-Mach relations, NASA Glenn CEA propellant benchmarks (RP-1, CH4, LH2, MMH), and Bartz-inspired regenerative cooling heat-transfer models, the simulator calculates real-time thrust, specific impulse (I_{\text{sp}}), shock-induced flow separation, and chamber wall thermal limits across four planetary environments (Earth, LEO Vacuum, Mars, and Titan) alongside 4th-Order Runge-Kutta (RK4) lunar descent guidance.
details:
Project Ghost: TEST STAND 39 // PROPULSION LAB & AERODYN-LUNAR SIMULATOR

1. What it does & How it works:
Project Ghost is an advanced, first-principles rocket propulsion telemetry and autonomous descent simulator. It models thermodynamic regimes, compressible nozzle flow (De Laval isentropic profiles), Bartz boundary heat coefficients, and chamber stability with regenerative cooling in real-time. It features an interactive web-based test stand allowing users to simulate various propellant cycles (RP-1/LOX, CH4/LOX, LH2/LOX, MMH/NTO) and high-performance structural materials (CuCrZr, Inconel 718, Carbon-Carbon composites).

2. Key Features & Benefits:
- Real-time numerical solvers for chamber pressure, specific impulse (Isp), wall thermal limits, exit Mach numbers, and flow regimes.
- 4th-Order Runge-Kutta (RK4) orbital trajectory integration and lunar mascon gravity modeling.
- Benchmarked directly against NASA Glenn CEA and NASA SP-194 stability criteria.

3. Tools & Technologies Used:
Built using HTML5, Vanilla JavaScript (Canvas telemetry rendering), and custom mathematical physics models. Hosted live on Netlify (https://venerable-otter-7d18ba.netlify.app).

4. Impact & Creativity:
It bridges the gap between theoretical aerospace engineering calculations and interactive web telemetry, offering an accessible, high-fidelity tool for evaluating rocket engine thermal limits and cis-lunar trajectory dynamics.
